method: rg-based audit of every weight upload/load seam (compute backend Upload dispatches, model loaders, device format-conversion kernels) at audit_head; each cell cites file:line evidence. SW-VERIFIED: no hardware runs; modes are read from committed code paths, not measured.

mode_semantics.native: The exact byte layout the kernel consumes is produced at load/upload time: either a byte-identical copy of the checkpoint payload, or a one-shot load-time pack/transpose/narrow that is cached and never re-executed on the inference hot path.
mode_semantics.runtime-repack: A transpose/swizzle/repack of weight or scale bytes executes on the per-forward/per-token hot path (per GEMM call). This is the speedup-erasing path the campaign targets.
mode_semantics.unknown: Not determinable from committed code at audit time. Every unknown cell names the missing probe.

device_axis_note: Device axis is vulkan/cuda/cpu per the ticket. Metal and ROCm ship weight paths too (internal/compute/metal_*.go, rocm backend) and are OUT OF SCOPE for this v1 baseline; next step is to extend the axis once these three devices are baselined.

DEFECT CELL - internal/compute/cuda/weight_formats.cuh:370-373 - the cuBLASLt W4A4 path (MatMulNVFP4) re-swizzles BOTH the weight scales and the activation scales into per-call scratch buffers on EVERY matmul call: nvfp4_lt_swizzle_scales(dWLinearScale, dWScaleScratch...) then nvfp4_lt_swizzle_scales(dALinearScale, dAScaleScratch...)

root cause chain: internal/model/modelopt_nvfp4.go:24-28 - the loader deliberately normalizes any TensorRT-produced scale swizzle back to the LINEAR ModelOpt layout at load time, so the device path must rebuild the tiled layout per call; landed 3d34127991

fix shape for the follow-on ticket: swizzle the immutable weight scales once at upload (they never change after load) and keep them resident; only activation scales need per-call work
